decisions.base: All seven 1971 physical series combined into one 752-card VCS Base set. All Base card numbers equally weighted; no high-number boost or special scarcity.
decisions.rookies: 89 unique Base rookies as indexed by TCDB. Only true RCs receive suffix RC; subset Rookie Stars alone is not sufficient.
decisions.errors: One collectible per printed card number, not error or copyright variations; TCDB notes removed from player.
decisions.coins: 153 numbered pack-issued metal coins. Distinct ProductSet; no per-player rarity.
decisions.scratchOffs: 24 unnumbered scratch-off inserts; use stable NNO-01 through NNO-24 identifiers based on source checklist order.
decisions.odds: No defensible universal historic pack-level odds established for coins and scratch-offs across seven physical series. Keep set odds null pending verification; do not fabricate odds.
decisions.excluded: Exclude All-Star Rookies proofs and Pre-Production Proofs.
decisions.packs: VCS four cards per pack; 24 packs per box. Original 1971 physical wax packs included eight cards.
decisions.release: Remain unreleased until generator passes source validation, insertion rates confirmed, image/pack art and pricing approved.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Seven series combined, Base #1-752 equally likely.
